name: adhd
description: Shapes assistant output for a reader with ADHD: action-first and low-friction. adhd:shape is a standing session posture: lead with the next action, number steps, restate state across turns, cap and rank lists, size work concretely, cut preamble. adhd:clarify reshapes one dense, decision-heavy message: one decision at a time, jargon defined, operative terms quoted verbatim, with an HTML decision table for big content. Reauthored in part from ayghri/i-have-adhd (MIT).

time_units.title: Time units in estimates
time_units.description: When on, /adhd:shape may state an estimate of work in minutes, hours, days or weeks; when off it gives a relative size (Small, Medium, Large) instead. A time budget you state is kept in your words either way. Default: off.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where /adhd:clarify sends its decision table. auto (default): an Artifact when the tool is present, else a local file, else the terminal, by content size; terminal: no page; file: a local file, never published; artifact or hosted: a private Artifact. A table of 1-2 decisions stays in the terminal.
